TOOLING BURST T4h-r1 — SPEC § 7 row "T4h" as EXTENDED: the burst_v2 "stretch-and-erode" template (Run C-5, E0-p step 3 second arm). task_id "T4h-r1". Your T4h burst_v1 delivered and the conductor baked it outside the sandbox (runs/C-5/t3/T4h-r1/bake_c1, seed-equal bakes byte-identical, VO1 measured: hold 2 f, residue 17.5 % held 0.6 s, release f72): it WORKS as a mechanism and FAILS as fire — eleven rigid chunks translating apart read as a shattered plate (the pre-registered falsification result, architecture § 2.2b WARN-9). And the fixed 0.5 parent scale shrank the peak to 155 px (the 1:1 body is 306 px): never shrink the effect to fit the instrument — enlarge the crop. Build burst_v2 beside v1 (v1 stays selectable for the A/B).

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 (the intro paragraph; the row "T4h — piece-burst template" — your contract, its Acceptance column is how your work is measured; the rows T4a (material), T4b (G1 component + effect-age clock), T4c (replay + bake), T4e as corrected (the pieces you consume)).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py (the G1 component emission, the effect-age clock, grey substitution), export/vfx_material.gdshader (erosion + band-step dissolve uniforms), export/replay.py (bake), oracle/vfx_measure.py (VO1 coverage over time), runs/C-5/t3/T4e-r1/pieces/pieces.json + the piece PNGs + peak_index.png (T4e-r1's delivered output: 24 pieces = 11 main-body spatial shards + 13 detached source islands < 40 px — consume its schema AS DELIVERED; do not re-decompose; pieces with area < 48 px are NOT animated: they show during the intact-peak hold and are dropped when the pieces fly), runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json + runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/frozen_orb/kit.json (kit schema precedent), tests/test_effect_kit.py and tests/test_godot_import.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot at /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot for headless import + bake runs (each < 2 min).

BUILD the burst_v2 template exactly as the extended SPEC row states, in the SAME `pieces` phase (kit field template: "burst_v2"; v1 untouched and still valid): (1) per piece compute root = the mask pixel nearest the burst centre and the radial axis root→tip (T4e-r1 records tip and pivot); (2) tongue pieces (dominant band ≤ 2 or distance > core radius) stay rooted — the root stays within 0.15 × core radius of its start — and stretch along their radial axis 1.0 → a seeded 1.6–2.0 over 0.25 s (ease-out), across-axis 1.0 → 0.7, no rotation beyond ±10°; core wedges (the pieces whose pivot lies inside the largest inscribed circle) swell 1.0 → 1.25 over 0.15 s and begin eroding first; implement the anisotropic stretch as a Sprite2D scale in a Node2D rotated to the piece's radial axis with the pivot offset set to the root; (3) erosion is ROOT-FIRST on the WHOLE-BODY distance field (the T4e peak_index distance transform from the centre, sampled per piece in its own UV space via the T4a erosion uniform — pass each piece a per-piece erosion threshold curve so the body opens from the centre outward and the silhouette stays continuous), plus the band-step dissolve (band 3 first); (4) residue: the eroded core + tongue roots remain AT THE IMPACT POINT at 15–25 % of peak coverage for residue_s (0.3–1.0 s), never scattered, then release; (5) bake crop 768² and parent impact scale 1.0 — extend export/replay.py's crop validation to accept 768 if it does not already (backward-compatible default 512), and bake with `--write-movie` at 768; (6) register a second kit `runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/kit.json` (same assets, template burst_v2) as the EIGHTH kits_v9 entry so both are reachable by Tab; (7) run the bake for v2 and (for comparison) v1 at scale 1.0/768 outside your sandbox IF the renderer works there — if it SIGABRTs as before, deliver the headless clock trace and say UNEVALUABLE (the conductor bakes outside); write runs/C-5/t3/T4h-r1/acceptance.json distinguishing rendered vs headless numbers as you did.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): kit validation rejects a missing mask / a pivot outside its mask / residue_fraction out of range; the emitted .tscn/.gd contain the piece nodes, the clock hook and the residue-by-erosion path (string-level checks + the headless import proof exit 0 on a fixture project); the seeded per-piece factor is deterministic.
ACCEPTANCE (extended row): the alpha silhouette stays ONE connected component (≥ 90 % of coverage in the largest component) through the expansion frames; extent ≥ 1.8 × peak extent within 0.25 s at parent scale 1.0; erosion to a 15–25 % residue centred within 0.3 × peak extent of the origin, held ≥ 0.3 s; two seeded bakes byte-identical; v1 still exports byte-identically; RED: residue reached by scaling, rigid translation of a tongue root beyond 0.15 × core radius, bakes differing between seed-equal runs. Report-not-stop (V17): if the bake cannot be measured, deliver the diagnosis. Then run the FULL suite: `cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -B tests/run_t0c.py` — expected: all green except the five standing reds (test_f04_outside_at_least_three; three test_named_genuine_annuli_retained subtests; test_synthetic_contract_and_grid); report tests_run, successful, and name every red.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/ (T4e owns peak_pieces.py; vfx_measure.py is frozen), any existing test file except the two named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4h-r1/ and the new kit directory runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_burst_e0p_v2/ (+ the one-line registration in kits_v9.json); runs/C-5/t3/T4h/ is the v1 record — read only. Existing functions keep their signatures and defaults; the six kits_v9 kits must export byte-identically. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4h-r1/. Write out/files.json listing every file you added or changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4h-r1"): files = every added/changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
